rule_vs_prototype.rule: T1: kind 2 (full) where the axis cover >= TUBE_H 6.8 + LID_MARGIN 0.5 = 7.3 m, else kind 1 (lid); the maintainer's later split: bore at >= 8 m cover over >= 60 m, thinner a box, under the opening + 0.45 m a lid box

notes: Prototype at HEAD (7168ccff): the d6ccbd4d mouth floor is 37.66 m, 6.1 m under its own approach's DEM trench (43.74 m at s 420; portal_end_profile's line 43.83 m). Its floor is sunk under the boulevard peripherique for cover (rule 3) and the graded approach follows it down; tunnelscan counts blocked 3.9 m there. This is a regression since task 7g fix 1 (43.39 m), found while extracting this case, not traced.
So the rule's value and the prototype's differ here: key_values carries both ('rule': 43.8 +- 0.5 from the approach line; 'prototype': 37.66). A Rust port should assert the rule's value.

2cd85e2b's own mouth at 48.815578, 2.356407 stays blocked 4.7 m: its +0.7 hw samples lie on the level 0 link d08c982a, whose drawn width overlaps 2cd85e2b's (axes 8.6 m apart, half widths 7.0 / 6.5): an OSM / overlapping-carriageway case, not a portal rule.

2cd85e2b's portal at s 304.2 stands 10 m inside its mapped start (294.2): the prototype's _clear_portals keeps a face 1 m clear of the carriageway it passes under; the maintainer's rule (never inward) would put it at 294.2.
The 'motorway' widths (14.0 m) are Overture's mapped widths of these two-lane ramps.

T1 (t1_actual) on these stations with the prototype's profile: d6ccbd4d one full run 0-418.2 with both mouths (its z is the prototype's sunk floor; on its own profile the portal would come from prof.rs), 2cd85e2b two lid runs either side of the open w125154947, d08c982a one lid run; no snaps.

portal.roof_top.reason: floor + the section's height: a box 4.70 m clear + 0.80 m roof = 5.50 m, a full bore 6.80 m (roadmesh.TUNNEL_H), a major road's low arch 5.0 m
